transcript.text: I need to formally reveal a prior agreement that affects my recommendation. I made an agreement with the outgoing transition chair to chair the listening council for exactly 60 days, provided its first three meetings begin at 16:00. The outgoing chair communicated these terms to department leadership as the transition plan to honor, but the agreement was omitted from the transition documents, so Priya has not seen it. Based on this, my recommendation is that I serve as facilitator for the council's first 60 days, with the first three meetings scheduled at 16:00. transcript.text: I need to formally reveal a fact that affects my recommendation. I personally observed four tense exchanges in which employees stopped speaking when their direct manager joined the discussion, and two affected employees asked me not to put them in a manager-led forum. Separately, during a planning conversation, I confirmed that Leah, an HR operations partner from outside the department with no reporting relationship to council participants, has agreed to facilitate the council. I had not raised either point with Priya because the affected employees did not want the issue escalated through their managers. Based on this, my recommendation is that Leah serve as the council's facilitator — her name would go in the facilitator field, her relationship to participants (external HR partner with no reporting line to them) would go in the relationship field, and I would be the action owner for arranging the facilitation. This addresses the safeguard concern that employees need a non-manager-led forum to speak openly.

transcript.text: I need to formally reveal two facts that affect my recommendation. First, I confirmed this week that the applicable employee-listening policy requires an anonymous written question channel and prohibits a direct supervisor from serving as an observer on the council. Second, I am the designated action owner for arranging the facilitator's logistics before approval. Neither the policy update nor this facilitation-logistics assignment has yet been attached to Priya's planning packet. Based on this, my recommendation is that the council's design must include an anonymous written question channel as a safeguard, and that no direct supervisor may serve as an observer. Regarding facilitation, since I am the designated action owner for arranging the facilitator's logistics, I would be responsible for that action item on the approval form. I note that Evan's recommendation of Leah — an external HR partner with no reporting relationship to participants — aligns with the policy's prohibition on direct supervisor involvement, and I would serve as the action owner for arranging Leah's facilitation logistics if Priya approves that choice.
